--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
METHODOLOGY
================================================================================
  WIN     : TP hit before SL — no time limit
  LOSS    : SL hit before TP — no time limit
  ONGOING : Neither hit as of report generation time
  UNKNOWN : Data fetch error

  EMA     : Seeded with SMA of first N closes, k = 2/(N+1)
  ADX     : Wilder smoothing, seeded with mean of first 14 DX values
  MACD    : EMA(12) − EMA(26); Signal = EMA(9) of MACD line
  Warmup  : 250 candles before window start (indicator seeding only)
  Entry   : Close of qualifying candle (N or N+1 after crossover)
  SL/TP   : Checked candle-by-candle from the bar after entry close
  Concurrent trades: blocked per symbol until SL or TP is hit
================================================================================
